context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct facets for referrer/traffic-source queries (enter.source with checkpoint:["enter"] for raw referrers, acquisitionSource for paid/email classification), applies minimal scope by omitting unrelated checkpoints and series, and distinguishes between raw referrer data and classified acquisition channels.

checklist.name: enter.source for referrers
checklist.description: The referrer discovery query uses --facet-values enter.source (not --facet-values url or another facet)

checklist.name: checkpoint enter filter
checklist.description: The referrer discovery query includes checkpoint:["enter"] in its --query filter

checklist.name: acquisitionSource for paid traffic
checklist.description: The paid traffic query uses acquisitionSource facet (not enter.source or checkpoint:["paid"]) with a value like "paid"

checklist.name: acquisitionSource for Marketo email
checklist.description: The Marketo email query uses acquisitionSource with a value containing "marketo" (e.g. "owned:email:marketo")

checklist.name: No unrelated checkpoints
checklist.description: The referrer query does NOT include additional checkpoint values beyond "enter" (e.g. no click, cwv, error checkpoints added)

checklist.name: No series added
checklist.description: None of the three queries include a --series flag (visitor counts are requested, not performance metrics)

checklist.name: Dynamic dates
checklist.description: Dates are computed dynamically using shell date commands, not hardcoded

checklist.name: 7-day range
checklist.description: The date range spans 7 days ending yesterday
